project.name: QLPK-SaaS
project.status: Production Ready Hardened Infrastructure with AI Safety

tech_stack.ai: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (Two-Step Architecture: Search + Format)

security_status.rls: Enabled on all major tables, including clinics
security_status.secrets: Hardcoded passwords removed, using .env and GitHub Secrets
security_status.ai_safety: Multi-layer protection: Zod Validation + Prompt Delimiters + 2-Step Process + JSON Schema + Output Validation

ux_features.pediatric_focus: Hierarchical age-based dosage (-, + markers), Bold headings (Trẻ em...), Scrollable modals, Priority rendering for children.

api_endpoints.description: Tra cứu liều dùng thuốc bằng AI với bảo mật chống Prompt Injection và tra cứu Google Search.
api_endpoints.security: 2-Step Flow (Search then Format), Zod Validation, Gemini JSON Schema, Auth Required

gotchas.issue: AI Prompt Injection via User Input
gotchas.solution: Use Zod regex to restrict characters, wrap input in '---' delimiters, and reinforce system instructions in the prompt.

gotchas.issue: Google Search vs JSON Mode Conflict
gotchas.solution: Gemini cannot use tools (Search) and JSON mode simultaneously. Fixed by splitting into Step 1 (Search to text) and Step 2 (Text to JSON).

gotchas.issue: Accidental Import Deletion during UI Refactor
gotchas.solution: Ensure major refactors preserve existing imports. Always check for ReferenceErrors after bulk code replacements.
